flat.scientific_use: Natural depth-null and real-photon SNR ladder; useful for flat-path identity, cover/resampling diagnostics, and detecting invented structure. The three exposure settings are not matched repeat realizations.

step_width.basis: directory-name label; Sony EXIF does not expose step width

tilted-sw4.scientific_use: Dense monotonic depth ramp for development-only coverage, planarity/order, and geometry commissioning; paired with tilted-sw10 it is a denser-sampling optical-improvement arm.

step_width.basis: directory-name label; Sony EXIF does not expose step width

tilted-sw10.scientific_use: Sparse monotonic depth ramp for development-only coverage commissioning and the lower-sampling member of the sw4/sw10 optical-improvement pair.

step_width.basis: directory-name label; Sony EXIF does not expose step width

very-tilted-all-axis-sw10.scientific_use: Strong all-axis depth ramp for development-only field geometry, plane/order, and difficult coverage commissioning; its geometry differs from tilted-sw10, so it is not a repeat.
